why_not_pass: Two single full-suite runs each reached 100% and then died before printing a summary, killed by the host's bulk-delete guard intercepting pytest's own cleanup of its accumulated temp garbage. A run with no summary has no verdict; calling it PASS would be exactly the '验证输出 != 验证机制' mistake this project keeps paying for.

runs.caveat: the output file was also truncated mid-run by a concurrent run, so the visible window is only the tail
the guard's own payload names the target: pytest's accumulated temp garbage, 196 items against a threshold of 50

remediation_in_flight.approach: split the 114 test files into batches, give each batch a fresh unique basetemp so pytest never accumulates the garbage the guard reacts to, read each batch's own summary, aggregate; an INCONCLUSIVE batch is split in half once instead of being re-run unchanged
